combinations.readout: Ca2+ transient amplitude in Trpv1+ DRG central terminals (lamina I and IIo) after single-pulse root stimulation
combinations.magnitude: GVIA alone 36-50% inhibition; further 15% with Aga; together about 70% block
combinations.model: ex vivo spinal cord, Trpv1-Cre x Ai96 GCaMP6s mice, sham and SNI
combinations.evidence_quote: In these conditions, we obtained between 36 and 50% inhibition of the Ca2+ transients in LI and LIIo with GVIA, and a further 15% inhibition with Aga (200 nM) when the L4 root was stimulated with a single pulse (Figures 4A, 4C, and 4E).
